intro.text: A brown Unkalaki drink, mixed in big metal bins, chilled overnight and served cold from a large pot.

items.text: Lunamor once made shiki for Bridge Four, but most of the bridgemen turned it down for beer.

He tried again during training at Narak. Huio added lazbo to a batch, annoying Lunamor, until he found the spice suited the drink perfectly. This time Bridge Four loved it, helped by how refreshing it was after hard training.
